info.name: opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me
info.description:
# 🇰🇭 OpenGeo Cambodia API - Postman Collection

Official Postman Collection for the **OpenGeo Cambodia API** — an open, high-performance REST API for Cambodia's geography data.

### 🌟 Core Highlights
- **4-Tier Administrative Hierarchy**: Complete coverage of 25 Provinces, 210 Districts, 1,661 Communes, and 14,576 Villages sourced from the **Ministry of Economy and Finance Open Data Portal** (`data.mef.gov.kh`).
- **100% Free & Open Access**: No API keys, no bearer tokens, and no rate-paywalls under the MIT license.
- **Sub-millisecond Latency (<1ms)**: In-memory O(1) hash maps and pre-serialized responses.
- **Smart Geocoding**: GPS reverse geocoding to 4 administrative tiers and forward address autocompletion.

### 🔧 Using Variables (No Environment File Needed)
This collection is completely self-contained using **Collection Variables**:
- `{{baseUrl}}`: Set to `https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me` by default. Switch to `http://localhost:3000` for local development.
- `{{provinceId}}`, `{{districtId}}`, `{{communeId}}`, `{{villageId}}`: Seeded with Phnom Penh / Khan Doun Penh IDs for cascading testing.
- `{{searchQuery}}`, `{{searchLevel}}`: Seeded with `'Doun Penh'` / `'district'`.
- `{{latitude}}`, `{{longitude}}`: Seeded with Phnom Penh center coordinates (`11.5714`, `104.9250`).

Import this file directly into Postman and click **Send**!
